label: VERIFIED
extraction: SPOQ wave-based dispatch and dual validation details. Wave-based topological dispatch computes parallel execution waves from task dependency graphs. Dual validation gates: planning validation before execution, code validation after execution to reduce rework cycles. Three-tier agent hierarchy: Opus workers, Sonnet reviewers, Haiku investigators for cost-quality optimization. Wave dispatch approaches critical-path lower bound (ratio 1.03-1.11, speedup up to 14.3x). On 2-slot local backend: stable 1.4x speedup. Planning coverage improved from 93.0 to 99.75, cyclic plans eliminated, parallelism lifted from 31.0 to 75.25. Dual validation reduces defect escape rate by 83%. Human-as-an-Agent (HaaA) integration: human specialist participates in decomposition and can be consulted during execution. File-system representation of epics/tasks, journal-based tracking for agent work sessions, skill framework with SKILL.md directories. Skills invoked via slash commands (/epic-planning, /agent-execution) expanding into full prompts with context from epic directory. Source code: gitlab.com/kenth56/spoq.
